relationships.evidence_quote: We identify Trim14 as a contributing factor of JAK1/STAT3 signaling in spinal dorsal horn neurons

relationships.subject: Dihydroquercetin
relationships.evidence_quote: Long-term DHQ treatment improves both nociceptive and affective symptoms by inhibiting spinal Trim14-JAK1-STAT3 axis in CIA mice.

relationships.subject: Dihydroquercetin
relationships.evidence_quote: Molecular docking revealed that DHQ occupies a conserved pocket in the Trim14 PRYSPRY substrate-recognition domain with sub-micromolar affinity

relationships.subject: Trim14
relationships.evidence_quote: Overall, chronic inflammatory pain induced anxiety-like behaviors, and Trim14 knockdown improved anxiety-like behaviors in CIA mice.

key_findings: Spinal Trim14 drives JAK1/STAT3 signaling, inflammatory pain and anxiety-depressive behaviors in CIA mice; Trim14 siRNA reverses them.
Dihydroquercetin binds Trim14 and its oral treatment suppresses the Trim14-JAK1-STAT3 axis and pain-depression comorbidity.
